# Introduction to GitHub {#sec-introduction-to-github}

In this chapter we will give a short introduction to GitHub and how it can be used to share code, and collaborate with others. We will mostly interact with GitHub from the command line using the GitHub CLI. See @sec-github-setup for information on how to install the CLI.

## What is GitHub?

GitHub is a web-based service that hosts Git repositories. Besides the obvious benifit of hosting your Git repositories online where you can access them from any computer with an internet connection, GitHub also has many features that facilitate collaboration, such as issue-tracking, code review, and pull requests.
